title: Classic Australian Lasagna
description: A twist on the traditional lasagna, featuring Australian flavors and unctuous cheese.

ingredients.name: Australian Lasagna Sheets (or regular lasagna sheets)

instructions: Cook the Australian lasagna sheets according to package instructions.
In a large mixing bowl, combine ricotta cheese, Parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, and unctuous cheese. Mix well.
Spread a layer of Australian tomato sauce on the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Arrange 4 lasagna sheets on top of the sauce.
Spread half of the ricotta cheese mixture on top of the lasagna sheets.
Sprinkle with half of the mozzarella cheese.
Repeat the layers: Australian tomato sauce, lasagna sheets, ricotta cheese mixture, and mozzarella cheese.
Top with the remaining mozzarella cheese.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
